items.title: Jon-Erik Kellso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: Yeah, he’s a good writer, good guy.

ctx.x: I’m glad to hear you say that because sometimes you — Floyd Levin, yeah.
Yeah, he’s a good writer, good guy.
Sometimes you wonder, when you read things that the critics or record reviewers write, if the musicians really agree with it you know.
